title: Fan-in
hints: Start one goroutine per input channel that copies every value to a shared output channel.
The output may be closed only after every copying goroutine has finished, the same pattern as closing_channels_02: a WaitGroup plus one goroutine that waits and then closes.
for _, c := range chans { wg.Add(1); go func() { defer wg.Done(); for v := range c { out <- v } }() }; go func() { wg.Wait(); close(out) }(); return out
